---
title: "Junction–isoform mapping and definition of risk/nonrisk isoform pairs"
output: html_document
---

## Purpose

A CAD-colocalized sQTL identifies an intron-excision junction whose usage changes
with the risk allele, but the junction alone does not say which transcript or
protein isoform carries the change. This script maps every CAD sQTL junction, and
every non-CAD VSMC sQTL junction used as background, onto the long-read VSMC
transcript models and classifies each junction as coding or noncoding, so that all
downstream scripts stratify junctions with one shared definition. Within each
LeafCutter cluster the junction whose usage increases with the risk allele is
designated the risk-associated junction and its counterpart the nonrisk-associated
junction; the two junctions are then resolved to the highest-expressed non-NMD
isoform that contains each, with a documented fallback when only one side of the
cluster is represented in the long-read data. The resulting unified pair table (94
sQTL-derived pairs plus the 13 AP-MS bait pairs fixed before proteomic detection)
is the input of every protein-level, peptide-level and interactome analysis.
Finally, each junction is projected onto amino-acid coordinates of every isoform
that contains it, because the junction-region property comparisons of script 03
need a protein-space window around the splice site.

## Manuscript outputs produced

- Fig. 4b–4d and Supplementary Table 13 — junction annotation status and coding
  class (the panels and the table are assembled by `10_figure_and_table_generation.Rmd`
  from the exports below).
- Supplementary Table 16 — the 94 computed risk/nonrisk isoform pairs (69 with both
  junctions represented, 25 with a counterpart selected from the gene's other
  isoforms) in 85 genes, plus the 13 AP-MS pairs; completed with property axes in
  script 06.
- Methods, "Mapping CAD sQTL junctions to transcripts and proteins" and "Definition
  of risk- and nonrisk-associated junctions and isoform pairs".

## Inputs

- `OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED` — integrated CAD sQTL junction table from script 01 (one row
  per junction × condition; `effect_direction` is already expressed relative to the
  CAD risk allele).
- `F_GENERAL_SQTL_LR` — all VSMC sQTL junctions mapped to long-read isoforms (the
  non-CAD background; Aherrahrou et al. 2023).
- `F_LEAFCUTTER_BED_PROLIF`, `F_LEAFCUTTER_BED_QUIESC` — LeafCutter cluster BEDs
  (cluster identifier ↔ junction coordinates, per culture condition).
- `F_LEAFCUTTER_COUNTS_PROLIF`, `F_LEAFCUTTER_COUNTS_QUIESC` — LeafCutter
  numerator/denominator counts per junction per donor (percent spliced in).
- `F_SMC_GTF`, `F_SMC_INTRON_COORDS`, `F_SMC_PSL` — long-read transcript models with
  CDS, their intron coordinates, and their exon block structure.
- `F_SQANTI_PROTEIN_CPM` — SQANTI Protein classification with CPM, NMD flag and ORF
  coordinates per isoform.
- `F_SMC_PROTEIN_FASTA` — predicted VSMC protein sequences.
- `F_GENCODE_V38_GTF` — GENCODE v38 (gene biotype).
- `F_APMS_BAIT_PAIRS` — the 13 AP-MS bait pairs (gene, risk PB, nonrisk PB).

## Outputs (in `RES_02`)

- `cad_junction_coding_classification.csv`, `noncad_junction_coding_classification.csv`
  — coding class per junction (scripts 04, 05, 10).
- `full_junction_universe_for_AS.csv`, `full_junction_isoform_map_for_AS.csv` — every
  CAD and non-CAD junction with its coding label, and every isoform containing it
  (scripts 04, 05, 10).
- `cad_junction_cluster_map.csv`, `cad_cluster_siblings_with_psi.csv`,
  `cad_risk_nonrisk_junction_pairs.csv` — cluster membership, sibling PSI and the
  risk/nonrisk junction assignment (script 04).
- `leafcutter_isoform_pairs_all.csv`, `leafcutter_isoform_pairs_full_pools.csv` —
  cluster-derived isoform pairs and the full candidate isoform pool per junction side
  (script 05).
- `leafcutter_isoform_pairs_unified.csv`, `leafcutter_isoform_pairs_unified_flagged.csv`
  — the unified pair table (strict, salvaged and AP-MS pairs) with the inclusion flags
  that define the 94-pair analysis set (scripts 03, 04, 05, 06,
  `python/compute_af3_metrics.py`).
- `junction_aa_mapping.csv` — amino-acid position and ±10-residue window of every
  pair junction in every isoform that contains it (script 03,
  `python/compute_af3_metrics.py`).

## Run order

Script 01 must have been run.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("config.R")
library(tidyverse)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(Biostrings)
library(pwalign)
library(data.table)

# purrr::reduce and IRanges::reduce share a name, and dplyr verbs are masked by
# S4 generics once GenomicRanges is attached; bind the intended versions.
reduce <- GenomicRanges::reduce
filter <- dplyr::filter
select <- dplyr::select
rename <- dplyr::rename
slice  <- dplyr::slice

set.seed(42)
ensure_dir(RES_02)

require_files(OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED, F_GENERAL_SQTL_LR,
              F_LEAFCUTTER_BED_PROLIF, F_LEAFCUTTER_BED_QUIESC,
              F_LEAFCUTTER_COUNTS_PROLIF, F_LEAFCUTTER_COUNTS_QUIESC,
              F_SMC_GTF, F_SMC_INTRON_COORDS, F_SMC_PSL, F_SQANTI_PROTEIN_CPM,
              F_SMC_PROTEIN_FASTA, F_GENCODE_V38_GTF, F_APMS_BAIT_PAIRS)

# Half-width of the protein window centred on each junction (±10 aa = 20 aa).
WINDOW_AA <- 10
```

# 1. Load sQTL junctions and long-read transcript models

The CAD set is every distinct junction in the integrated colocalization table; the
non-CAD background is every VSMC sQTL junction whose cluster is not a CAD cluster,
so that the two sets do not share junctions. Junction keys use the LeafCutter
coordinate convention (`chr:start:end` of the excised intron) throughout, because
every join in this and the downstream scripts is made on that key.

```{r load_core_data}
cad_sqtls <- read_tsv(OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    junction_id  = paste(chr, intron_start, intron_end, strand, sep = ":"),
    junction_key = paste(chr, intron_start, intron_end, sep = ":")
  )

cad_junctions <- cad_sqtls %>%
  distinct(chr, intron_start, intron_end, strand, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(junction_key, chr, intron_start, intron_end, strand, gene_name, effect_direction)
cat("CAD sQTL distinct junctions:", nrow(cad_junctions), "\n")

general_sqtls_raw <- read_tsv(F_GENERAL_SQTL_LR, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(junction_key = paste(chr, intron_start, intron_end, sep = ":"))

# Exclude CAD clusters from the background.
cad_cluster_ids <- unique(cad_sqtls$cluster)
general_sqtls <- general_sqtls_raw %>% filter(!cluster_id %in% cad_cluster_ids)
general_junctions <- general_sqtls %>%
  distinct(chr, intron_start, intron_end, junction_id, junction_key, .keep_all = TRUE)
cat("Non-CAD VSMC sQTL distinct junctions:", nrow(general_junctions), "\n")

cad_junc_gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(cad_junctions, seqnames.field = "chr",
                                        start.field = "intron_start", end.field = "intron_end",
                                        keep.extra.columns = TRUE)
seqlevelsStyle(cad_junc_gr) <- "UCSC"
general_junc_gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(general_junctions, seqnames.field = "chr",
                                            start.field = "intron_start", end.field = "intron_end",
                                            keep.extra.columns = TRUE)
seqlevelsStyle(general_junc_gr) <- "UCSC"

# Long-read transcript models: CDS intervals (pooled and per transcript).
smc_gtf    <- rtracklayer::import(F_SMC_GTF)
smc_gtf_df <- as.data.frame(smc_gtf)
smc_cds_gr <- smc_gtf_df %>% filter(type == "CDS") %>%
  makeGRangesFromDataFrame(keep.extra.columns = TRUE)
seqlevelsStyle(smc_cds_gr) <- "UCSC"

cds_by_transcript <- smc_gtf_df %>%
  filter(type == "CDS") %>%
  mutate(pb_id = str_extract(transcript_id, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_id)) %>%
  makeGRangesFromDataFrame(seqnames.field = "seqnames", start.field = "start",
                           end.field = "end", strand.field = "strand",
                           keep.extra.columns = TRUE)
seqlevelsStyle(cds_by_transcript) <- "UCSC"
cds_lookup <- split(cds_by_transcript, cds_by_transcript$pb_id)

# SQANTI Protein table (CPM, NMD, structural category, ORF coordinates).
sqanti_protein <- read_csv(F_SQANTI_PROTEIN_CPM, show_col_types = FALSE)
colnames(sqanti_protein)[colnames(sqanti_protein) == "pb"] <- "pb_acc"

# Junction -> isoform map: one row per (intron, transcript); the PB accession is
# embedded in trans_id as GENE|PB.X.Y|N.
smc_junc_isoform <- read_tsv(F_SMC_INTRON_COORDS, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(junction_key = paste(chr, intron_start, intron_end, sep = ":"),
         pb_id = str_extract(trans_id, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_id))
cat("Junction-isoform links in the long-read models:", nrow(smc_junc_isoform), "\n")

cad_junction_keys     <- unique(cad_junctions$junction_key)
general_junction_keys <- unique(general_junctions$junction_key)
```

# 2. Coding classification of junctions

A junction is called coding when it overlaps a CDS interval of the long-read models
and at least one isoform containing it carries a SQANTI structural category
compatible with a predicted ORF; otherwise it is assigned to the UTR of a coding
gene, to a lncRNA, or to another biotype from GENCODE v38. The full universe of
CAD and non-CAD junctions is exported with this label so that the splice-event
classification (script 04) can see noncoding junctions while every protein-level
analysis restricts to the same coding subset.

```{r junction_classification}
# Gene biotype from GENCODE v38 (gene-level records only).
gc_gtf <- rtracklayer::import(F_GENCODE_V38_GTF)
gene_biotype <- as.data.frame(gc_gtf) %>%
  filter(type == "gene") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_name, gene_type) %>%
  distinct(gene_name, .keep_all = TRUE)
rm(gc_gtf); invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))

coding_categories <- c("full-splice_match", "incomplete-splice_match",
                       "novel_in_catalog", "novel_not_in_catalog")

# CAD junctions
cad_classification <- cad_junctions %>%
  mutate(overlaps_cds = countOverlaps(cad_junc_gr, smc_cds_gr, type = "any") > 0) %>%
  left_join(gene_biotype, by = "gene_name")

junc_has_cds_isoform <- smc_junc_isoform %>%
  filter(junction_key %in% cad_junction_keys) %>%
  left_join(sqanti_protein %>% dplyr::select(pb_acc, tx_cat), by = c("pb_id" = "pb_acc")) %>%
  group_by(junction_key) %>%
  summarise(n_isoforms = n(),
            n_coding_isoforms = sum(tx_cat %in% coding_categories, na.rm = TRUE),
            any_coding = n_coding_isoforms > 0, .groups = "drop")

cad_classification <- cad_classification %>%
  left_join(junc_has_cds_isoform, by = "junction_key") %>%
  mutate(coding_class = case_when(
    overlaps_cds & any_coding ~ "CDS (at least partial)",
    !overlaps_cds & any_coding ~ "UTR/noncoding region of coding gene",
    !is.na(gene_type) & gene_type == "lncRNA" ~ "lncRNA",
    !is.na(gene_type) & gene_type == "protein_coding" & !any_coding ~
      "Protein-coding gene, no CDS isoform captured",
    is.na(gene_type) ~ "Unknown biotype",
    TRUE ~ paste0("Other (", gene_type, ")")
  ))

# Non-CAD junctions (the background table names the gene column `gene`)
gen_classification <- general_junctions %>%
  mutate(overlaps_cds = countOverlaps(general_junc_gr, smc_cds_gr, type = "any") > 0)
if ("gene_name" %in% colnames(gen_classification)) {
  gen_classification <- gen_classification %>% left_join(gene_biotype, by = "gene_name")
} else if ("gene" %in% colnames(gen_classification)) {
  gen_classification <- gen_classification %>% left_join(gene_biotype, by = c("gene" = "gene_name"))
}

noncad_junc_has_cds <- smc_junc_isoform %>%
  filter(junction_key %in% general_junction_keys, !junction_key %in% cad_junction_keys) %>%
  left_join(sqanti_protein %>% dplyr::select(pb_acc, tx_cat), by = c("pb_id" = "pb_acc")) %>%
  group_by(junction_key) %>%
  summarise(any_coding = any(tx_cat %in% coding_categories, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

gen_classification <- gen_classification %>%
  left_join(noncad_junc_has_cds, by = "junction_key") %>%
  mutate(coding_class = case_when(
    overlaps_cds & any_coding ~ "CDS (at least partial)",
    !overlaps_cds & any_coding ~ "UTR/noncoding region of coding gene",
    !is.na(gene_type) & gene_type == "lncRNA" ~ "lncRNA",
    TRUE ~ "Other/Unknown"
  ))

cat("CAD junctions in CDS:", sum(cad_classification$coding_class == "CDS (at least partial)"),
    "of", nrow(cad_classification), "\n")

write_csv(cad_classification %>%
            dplyr::select(junction_key, gene_name, effect_direction, overlaps_cds,
                          any_of("gene_type"), any_coding, coding_class),
          OUT_CAD_JUNCTION_CODING)
write_csv(gen_classification %>%
            dplyr::select(junction_key, any_of(c("gene", "gene_name")), overlaps_cds,
                          any_of("gene_type"), any_coding, coding_class),
          OUT_NONCAD_JUNCTION_CODING)

# Full splicing universe (coding and noncoding) with the coding label, and every
# isoform carrying each junction, for the splice-event classification.
full_junction_universe <- bind_rows(cad_classification %>% mutate(set = "CAD"),
                                    gen_classification %>% mutate(set = "nonCAD"))
if (!"gene_name" %in% names(full_junction_universe)) full_junction_universe$gene_name <- NA_character_
if ("gene" %in% names(full_junction_universe)) {
  full_junction_universe <- full_junction_universe %>% mutate(gene_name = coalesce(gene_name, gene))
}
full_junction_universe <- full_junction_universe %>%
  dplyr::select(set, junction_key, gene_name, any_of("effect_direction"),
                overlaps_cds, any_of("gene_type"), any_coding, coding_class) %>%
  distinct()

full_junction_isoform_map <- smc_junc_isoform %>%
  filter(junction_key %in% c(cad_junction_keys, general_junction_keys)) %>%
  distinct(junction_key, pb_id)

write_csv(full_junction_universe,    OUT_JUNCTION_UNIVERSE)
write_csv(full_junction_isoform_map, OUT_JUNCTION_ISOFORM_MAP)
```

# 3. LeafCutter clusters, sibling junctions and percent spliced in

LeafCutter cluster identifiers are not stable between runs, so CAD junctions are
matched to the cluster BED files by genomic coordinates. Every junction of a matched
cluster (its "siblings") is retrieved, and the mean percent spliced in (PSI) of each
junction is computed across donors from the LeafCutter numerator/denominator counts,
because PSI is the criterion used below to pick a counterpart junction when a cluster
contains only one CAD-colocalized junction.

```{r load_bed}
parse_bed_clusters <- function(bed_path, cond_label) {
  bed <- fread(bed_path, select = 1:4, header = TRUE)
  colnames(bed) <- c("chrom", "start", "end", "ID")
  bed %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(junction_key = paste0(chrom, ":", start, ":", end),
           cluster_bed  = str_extract(ID, "clu_\\d+_[+-]"),
           ensg         = str_extract(ID, "ENSG\\d+\\.\\d+"),
           condition    = cond_label) %>%
    select(junction_key, cluster_bed, chrom, start, end, ensg, condition)
}

bed_all <- bind_rows(parse_bed_clusters(F_LEAFCUTTER_BED_PROLIF, "Proliferative"),
                     parse_bed_clusters(F_LEAFCUTTER_BED_QUIESC, "Quiescent")) %>%
  distinct(junction_key, cluster_bed, .keep_all = TRUE)
cat("LeafCutter junctions:", nrow(bed_all), "in", n_distinct(bed_all$cluster_bed), "clusters\n")
```

```{r match_cad}
cad_info <- cad_sqtls %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(junction_key, gene_name, cluster_sqtl = cluster, slope, effect_direction, Condition) %>%
  distinct(junction_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(junction_key))

# Coordinate-based match; a junction present in both conditions is kept once.
cad_matched <- cad_info %>%
  inner_join(bed_all %>% select(junction_key, cluster_bed) %>% distinct(), by = "junction_key") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  { .[!duplicated(.[, c("junction_key", "cluster_bed")]), ] } %>%
  as_tibble()

cad_dedup <- as.data.frame(cad_matched)
cad_dedup <- as_tibble(cad_dedup[!duplicated(cad_dedup$junction_key), ])
cat("CAD junctions matched to a LeafCutter cluster:", nrow(cad_dedup), "/", nrow(cad_info), "\n")
```

```{r extract_siblings}
matched_clusters <- unique(cad_dedup$cluster_bed)

siblings <- bed_all %>%
  filter(cluster_bed %in% matched_clusters) %>%
  left_join(cad_dedup %>% select(junction_key, gene_name, slope, effect_direction),
            by = "junction_key") %>%
  mutate(is_cad_sqtl = !is.na(gene_name))

# Fill the gene name of non-sQTL siblings from the CAD junction of their cluster.
gene_map <- as.data.frame(cad_dedup[, c("cluster_bed", "gene_name")])
gene_map <- gene_map[!duplicated(gene_map$cluster_bed), ]
colnames(gene_map) <- c("cluster_bed", "cluster_gene")
siblings <- siblings %>%
  left_join(as_tibble(gene_map), by = "cluster_bed") %>%
  mutate(gene_name = coalesce(gene_name, cluster_gene)) %>%
  select(-cluster_gene)
```

```{r load_counts}
# Each cell of the cleaned counts is "numerator/denominator" per sample; PSI per
# sample is their ratio and the mean is taken over samples with coverage.
parse_cleaned_counts <- function(counts_path, cond_label) {
  raw <- fread(counts_path, header = TRUE, nThread = 1)
  id_col <- colnames(raw)[1]
  sample_cols <- colnames(raw)[-1]
  ids <- raw[[id_col]]

  # Row identifier format: chr11:133778:134564:chr11:clu_1_-_ENSG00000230724.9
  parsed <- tibble(
    raw_id = ids,
    chrom  = str_extract(ids, "^chr[^:]+"),
    start  = as.integer(str_extract(ids, "(?<=:)\\d+(?=:\\d+:chr)")),
    end    = as.integer(str_extract(ids, "(?<=:\\d{1,12}:)\\d+(?=:chr)")),
    cluster_counts = str_extract(ids, "clu_\\d+_[+-]")
  ) %>%
    mutate(junction_key = paste0(chrom, ":", start, ":", end))

  psi_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(raw)), function(i) {
    vals   <- as.character(raw[i, ..sample_cols])
    parts  <- str_split(vals, "/", simplify = TRUE)
    nums   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts[, 1]))
    denoms <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts[, 2]))
    valid  <- !is.na(nums) & !is.na(denoms) & denoms > 0
    if (sum(valid) == 0) return(c(mean_psi = NA_real_, sd_psi = NA_real_,
                                  mean_num = NA_real_, sd_num = NA_real_,
                                  mean_denom = NA_real_, sd_denom = NA_real_,
                                  n_expressed = 0L))
    psi_vals <- nums[valid] / denoms[valid]
    c(mean_psi = mean(psi_vals), sd_psi = sd(psi_vals),
      mean_num = mean(nums[valid]), sd_num = sd(nums[valid]),
      mean_denom = mean(denoms[valid]), sd_denom = sd(denoms[valid]),
      n_expressed = sum(valid))
  })

  bind_rows(lapply(psi_list, as_tibble_row)) %>%
    bind_cols(parsed) %>%
    mutate(condition = cond_label)
}

counts_all <- bind_rows(parse_cleaned_counts(F_LEAFCUTTER_COUNTS_PROLIF, "Proliferative"),
                        parse_cleaned_counts(F_LEAFCUTTER_COUNTS_QUIESC, "Quiescent"))
```

```{r annotate_psi}
# One PSI record per (junction, cluster); the first non-missing record is used.
siblings_psi <- siblings %>%
  left_join(counts_all %>%
              select(junction_key, condition, mean_psi, sd_psi, mean_num, sd_num,
                     mean_denom, sd_denom, n_expressed, cluster_counts),
            by = "junction_key")
siblings_psi_dedup <- as.data.frame(siblings_psi)
siblings_psi_dedup <- as_tibble(
  siblings_psi_dedup[!duplicated(siblings_psi_dedup[, c("junction_key", "cluster_bed")]), ])
```

# 4. Risk- and nonrisk-associated junctions

The direction of effect is taken from `effect_direction`, which script 01 expresses
relative to the CAD risk allele (not the sQTL slope sign, whose reference is the
alternative allele). A junction whose usage increases with the risk allele is the
risk-associated junction; its nonrisk counterpart is another CAD-colocalized junction
of the same cluster with the opposite direction or, when none exists, the
highest-PSI non-colocalized sibling. Clusters where the CAD junction decreases with
the risk allele are handled symmetrically.

```{r assign_pairs}
pair_results <- list()

for (cl in unique(cad_dedup$cluster_bed)) {
  cl_sibs    <- siblings_psi_dedup %>% filter(cluster_bed == cl)
  cl_cad     <- cl_sibs %>% filter(is_cad_sqtl)
  cl_non_cad <- cl_sibs %>% filter(!is_cad_sqtl)
  if (nrow(cl_cad) == 0) next

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(cl_cad))) {
    cad_jnc   <- cl_cad$junction_key[i]
    cad_slope <- cl_cad$slope[i]
    cad_dir   <- cl_cad$effect_direction[i]
    cad_gene  <- cl_cad$gene_name[i]
    cad_psi   <- cl_cad$mean_psi[i]
    if (is.na(cad_slope) || is.na(cad_dir)) next

    if (cad_dir == "Increased") {
      risk_junction <- cad_jnc
      risk_psi      <- cad_psi
      direction     <- "risk_used"
      neg_sibs <- cl_cad %>% filter(effect_direction == "Decreased")
      if (nrow(neg_sibs) > 0) {
        complement <- neg_sibs$junction_key[1]; complement_psi <- neg_sibs$mean_psi[1]
        complement_source <- "cad_opposite_direction"
      } else if (nrow(cl_non_cad) > 0) {
        best_idx <- which.max(cl_non_cad$mean_psi)
        complement <- cl_non_cad$junction_key[best_idx]; complement_psi <- cl_non_cad$mean_psi[best_idx]
        complement_source <- "sibling_highest_psi"
      } else {
        complement <- NA; complement_psi <- NA; complement_source <- "no_sibling"
      }
      nonrisk_junction <- complement
      nonrisk_psi      <- complement_psi
    } else if (cad_dir == "Decreased") {
      nonrisk_junction <- cad_jnc
      nonrisk_psi      <- cad_psi
      direction        <- "risk_excluded"
      pos_sibs <- cl_cad %>% filter(effect_direction == "Increased")
      if (nrow(pos_sibs) > 0) {
        complement <- pos_sibs$junction_key[1]; complement_psi <- pos_sibs$mean_psi[1]
        complement_source <- "cad_opposite_direction"
      } else if (nrow(cl_non_cad) > 0) {
        best_idx <- which.max(cl_non_cad$mean_psi)
        complement <- cl_non_cad$junction_key[best_idx]; complement_psi <- cl_non_cad$mean_psi[best_idx]
        complement_source <- "sibling_highest_psi"
      } else {
        complement <- NA; complement_psi <- NA; complement_source <- "no_sibling"
      }
      risk_junction <- complement
      risk_psi      <- complement_psi
    } else {
      next
    }

    pair_results[[length(pair_results) + 1]] <- tibble(
      cluster_bed = cl, gene_name = cad_gene, cad_sqtl_junction = cad_jnc,
      slope = cad_slope, effect_direction = cad_dir, direction = direction,
      risk_junction = risk_junction, risk_psi = risk_psi,
      nonrisk_junction = nonrisk_junction, nonrisk_psi = nonrisk_psi,
      complement_source = complement_source,
      n_junctions_in_cluster = nrow(cl_sibs),
      mean_cluster_depth = mean(cl_sibs$mean_denom, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }
}
pairs_df <- bind_rows(pair_results)
cat("Risk/nonrisk junction pairs:", nrow(pairs_df), "\n")
```

```{r export_cluster_tables}
write_csv(pairs_df, OUT_CAD_JUNCTION_PAIRS)
write_csv(siblings_psi_dedup, OUT_CAD_CLUSTER_SIBLINGS)
write_csv(cad_dedup %>% select(junction_key, gene_name, cluster_bed, slope, effect_direction, Condition),
          OUT_CAD_CLUSTER_MAP)
```

# 5. Candidate isoforms per junction

Every long-read isoform that contains a risk or nonrisk junction is annotated with
its CPM, NMD status, structural category and protein sequence; this annotated map is
the candidate pool from which pairs are selected and is also exported in full for
the peptide-evidence analysis, which needs the complete isoform pool on each side
rather than only the chosen pair.

```{r map_junctions_to_isoforms}
smc_junc_iso <- smc_junc_isoform %>% rename(pb_acc = pb_id)

smc_fasta_set <- readAAStringSet(F_SMC_PROTEIN_FASTA, format = "fasta")
smc_fasta_df <- tibble(protein_id = names(smc_fasta_set), sequence = as.character(smc_fasta_set)) %>%
  mutate(pb_acc = str_extract(protein_id, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"),
         protein_length = nchar(sequence))
rm(smc_fasta_set); invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))

all_junctions_needed <- unique(c(pairs_df$risk_junction[!is.na(pairs_df$risk_junction)],
                                 pairs_df$nonrisk_junction[!is.na(pairs_df$nonrisk_junction)]))

junc_iso_annotated <- smc_junc_iso %>%
  filter(junction_key %in% all_junctions_needed) %>%
  select(junction_key, pb_acc) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(sqanti_protein %>% select(pb_acc, CPM, is_nmd, tx_cat, gene), by = "pb_acc") %>%
  left_join(smc_fasta_df %>% select(pb_acc, protein_length, sequence), by = "pb_acc") %>%
  mutate(is_nmd = replace_na(is_nmd, FALSE), CPM = replace_na(CPM, 0))
```

# 6. Selection of the isoform pair for each junction pair

On each side the candidate isoforms are ranked by a score that places every non-NMD
isoform above every NMD-flagged isoform and orders within each tier by CPM
(score = CPM + 1000 for non-NMD), so predicted-NMD isoforms are used only when no
other isoform contains the junction. If the top choice is the same transcript on both
sides, the nonrisk side is demoted to its next-best candidate, then the risk side,
and finally a nonrisk isoform is taken from all isoforms of the gene lacking the
risk junction. Percent identity between the two protein sequences is recorded as a
position-wise match over the shorter sequence, normalised by the longer.

```{r select_best_pairs}
best_pairs_list <- list()
full_pools_list <- list()

# Gene-level pool: any isoform of the gene with a protein sequence.
gene_iso_pool <- junc_iso_annotated %>%
  filter(!is.na(sequence)) %>%
  group_by(gene_name = gene, pb_acc) %>%
  summarise(CPM = max(CPM, na.rm = TRUE), is_nmd = any(is_nmd, na.rm = TRUE),
            tx_cat = dplyr::first(na.omit(tx_cat)),
            protein_length = max(protein_length, na.rm = TRUE),
            sequence = dplyr::first(na.omit(sequence)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(score = CPM + ifelse(!is_nmd, 1000, 0))

pick_top <- function(candidates, exclude_pbs = character()) {
  ok <- candidates %>% filter(!pb_acc %in% exclude_pbs) %>% arrange(desc(score))
  if (nrow(ok) == 0) return(NULL)
  ok[1, ]
}

# Best isoform of the gene that does not contain target_junction.
gene_pool_pick <- function(gene_target, target_junction, exclude_pbs = character()) {
  pool <- gene_iso_pool %>% filter(gene_name == gene_target, !pb_acc %in% exclude_pbs)
  if (nrow(pool) == 0) return(NULL)
  iso_with_target <- junc_iso_annotated %>% filter(junction_key == target_junction) %>%
    pull(pb_acc) %>% unique()
  pool <- pool %>% filter(!pb_acc %in% iso_with_target)
  if (nrow(pool) == 0) return(NULL)
  pool %>% arrange(desc(score)) %>% slice(1)
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(pairs_df))) {
  row  <- pairs_df[i, ]
  gene <- row$gene_name
  if (is.na(row$risk_junction) || is.na(row$nonrisk_junction)) next
  if (row$risk_junction == row$nonrisk_junction) next

  risk_isos <- junc_iso_annotated %>%
    filter(junction_key == row$risk_junction, !is.na(sequence)) %>%
    mutate(score = CPM + ifelse(!is_nmd, 1000, 0)) %>% arrange(desc(score))
  nonrisk_isos <- junc_iso_annotated %>%
    filter(junction_key == row$nonrisk_junction, !is.na(sequence)) %>%
    mutate(score = CPM + ifelse(!is_nmd, 1000, 0)) %>% arrange(desc(score))
  if (nrow(risk_isos) == 0 || nrow(nonrisk_isos) == 0) next

  full_pools_list[[length(full_pools_list) + 1]] <- bind_rows(
    risk_isos %>% transmute(gene_name = gene, cluster_bed = row$cluster_bed,
                            cad_sqtl_junction = row$cad_sqtl_junction, slope = row$slope,
                            direction = row$direction, junction_key = row$risk_junction,
                            side = "risk", pb_acc, CPM, is_nmd, tx_cat, protein_length, score),
    nonrisk_isos %>% transmute(gene_name = gene, cluster_bed = row$cluster_bed,
                               cad_sqtl_junction = row$cad_sqtl_junction, slope = row$slope,
                               direction = row$direction, junction_key = row$nonrisk_junction,
                               side = "nonrisk", pb_acc, CPM, is_nmd, tx_cat, protein_length, score))

  best_risk    <- risk_isos[1, ]
  best_nonrisk <- nonrisk_isos[1, ]
  pair_method  <- "top_risk_top_nonrisk"

  if (best_risk$pb_acc == best_nonrisk$pb_acc) {
    deg_pb <- best_risk$pb_acc
    alt_nonrisk <- pick_top(nonrisk_isos, exclude_pbs = deg_pb)
    if (!is.null(alt_nonrisk)) {
      best_nonrisk <- alt_nonrisk
      pair_method  <- "top_risk_secondbest_nonrisk"
    } else {
      alt_risk <- pick_top(risk_isos, exclude_pbs = deg_pb)
      if (!is.null(alt_risk)) {
        best_risk   <- alt_risk
        pair_method <- "secondbest_risk_top_nonrisk"
      } else {
        gp_nr <- gene_pool_pick(gene, target_junction = row$risk_junction, exclude_pbs = deg_pb)
        if (!is.null(gp_nr)) {
          best_nonrisk <- gp_nr %>% transmute(pb_acc, CPM, is_nmd, tx_cat, protein_length, sequence, score)
          pair_method  <- "gene_pool_nonrisk"
        } else {
          next
        }
      }
    }
  }

  r_seq  <- best_risk$sequence
  nr_seq <- best_nonrisk$sequence
  min_len <- min(nchar(r_seq), nchar(nr_seq))
  max_len <- max(nchar(r_seq), nchar(nr_seq))
  pct_identity <- if (min_len > 0) {
    r_chars  <- strsplit(substr(r_seq,  1, min_len), "")[[1]]
    nr_chars <- strsplit(substr(nr_seq, 1, min_len), "")[[1]]
    round(sum(r_chars == nr_chars) / max_len * 100, 1)
  } else 0

  best_pairs_list[[length(best_pairs_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
    gene_name = gene, cluster_bed = row$cluster_bed, cad_sqtl_junction = row$cad_sqtl_junction,
    slope = row$slope, direction = row$direction,
    risk_junction = row$risk_junction, risk_pb = best_risk$pb_acc, risk_cpm = best_risk$CPM,
    risk_length_aa = best_risk$protein_length, risk_nmd = best_risk$is_nmd,
    risk_tx_cat = ifelse("tx_cat" %in% colnames(best_risk), best_risk$tx_cat, NA),
    risk_seq = r_seq,
    nonrisk_junction = row$nonrisk_junction, nonrisk_pb = best_nonrisk$pb_acc,
    nonrisk_cpm = best_nonrisk$CPM, nonrisk_length_aa = best_nonrisk$protein_length,
    nonrisk_nmd = best_nonrisk$is_nmd,
    nonrisk_tx_cat = ifelse("tx_cat" %in% colnames(best_nonrisk), best_nonrisk$tx_cat, NA),
    nonrisk_seq = nr_seq,
    percent_identity = pct_identity, combined_cpm = best_risk$CPM + best_nonrisk$CPM,
    n_risk_candidates = nrow(risk_isos), n_nonrisk_candidates = nrow(nonrisk_isos),
    complement_source = row$complement_source, pair_method = pair_method,
    source = "leafcutter_cluster"
  )
}

lc_pairs            <- bind_rows(best_pairs_list)
lc_pairs_full_pools <- bind_rows(full_pools_list)
stopifnot("degenerate pairs remain" = !any(lc_pairs$risk_pb == lc_pairs$nonrisk_pb))
cat("Cluster-derived isoform pairs:", nrow(lc_pairs), "in", n_distinct(lc_pairs$gene_name), "genes\n")

write_csv(lc_pairs,            OUT_PAIRS_ALL)
write_csv(lc_pairs_full_pools, OUT_PAIRS_FULL_POOLS)
```

# 7. Protein-space coordinates of each junction

For the junction-region property comparisons, the splice site must be located within
the protein of every isoform that contains it. The exon block structure (PSL) gives
the mRNA position of the exon–exon boundary, the SQANTI ORF coordinates convert it to
a codon index, and the ±`WINDOW_AA` residues around that index are extracted from the
predicted protein. The PSL stores exons as 0-based half-open intervals in genomic
order on both strands, whereas LeafCutter introns are 1-based inclusive, so the
boundary is matched with a one-base tolerance and the cumulative exon length is
summed from the transcript 5′ end (reverse genomic order on the minus strand).

```{r junction_aa_resources}
psl <- read_tsv(F_SMC_PSL,
                col_names = c("matches", "misMatches", "repMatches", "nCount",
                              "qNumInsert", "qBaseInsert", "tNumInsert", "tBaseInsert",
                              "strand", "qName", "qSize", "qStart", "qEnd",
                              "tName", "tSize", "tStart", "tEnd",
                              "blockCount", "blockSizes", "qStarts", "tStarts"),
                col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(pb_acc = str_extract(qName, "^PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"),
         tStart = as.integer(tStart), tEnd = as.integer(tEnd),
         blockCount = as.integer(blockCount)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_acc))

parse_int_vec <- function(s) as.integer(str_split(str_remove(s, ",$"), ",")[[1]])
psl_exons <- psl %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(block_sizes_v = list(parse_int_vec(blockSizes)),
         t_starts_v    = list(parse_int_vec(tStarts))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(pb_acc, chr = tName, strand_psl = strand, tStart, tEnd, blockCount, block_sizes_v, t_starts_v)

# ORF positions in mRNA coordinates.
sqanti <- read_csv(F_SQANTI_PROTEIN_CPM, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(pb_acc = pb, strand_sq = strand, seqname, orf_start, orf_end, orf_len, orf_frame, len) %>%
  filter(!is.na(orf_start), !is.na(orf_end))

fasta <- readAAStringSet(F_SMC_PROTEIN_FASTA)
protein_lookup <- tibble(pb_acc = str_extract(names(fasta), "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"),
                         protein_seq = as.character(fasta)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pb_acc)) %>%
  mutate(protein_seq = str_remove(protein_seq, "\\*$")) %>%
  distinct(pb_acc, .keep_all = TRUE)
rm(fasta); invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE))

# Amino-acid position and window of one intron in one isoform.
compute_junction_aa <- function(pb_acc, intron_start, intron_end, strand,
                                exons_tStarts, exons_blockSizes,
                                orf_start_mrna, orf_end_mrna, protein_seq) {
  exon_g_start <- exons_tStarts
  exon_g_end   <- exons_tStarts + exons_blockSizes
  n_exons <- length(exon_g_start)
  if (n_exons < 2) return(tibble(status = "single_exon"))

  # Intron i lies between exon i and exon i + 1 (genomic order); PSL exon ends are
  # 0-based so exon_end == intron_start - 1 and exon_start == intron_end, ±1.
  upstream_exon_idx <- NA_integer_
  for (i in seq_len(n_exons - 1)) {
    if (abs(exon_g_end[i] - (intron_start - 1)) <= 1 &&
        abs(exon_g_start[i + 1] - intron_end) <= 1) { upstream_exon_idx <- i; break }
  }
  if (is.na(upstream_exon_idx)) return(tibble(status = "exon_not_found"))

  # mRNA position of the last base before the junction: cumulative exon length from
  # the transcript 5' end (genomic start on +, genomic end on -).
  mrna_junction_pos <- if (strand == "+") {
    sum(exons_blockSizes[1:upstream_exon_idx])
  } else {
    sum(exons_blockSizes[(upstream_exon_idx + 1):n_exons])
  }

  if (mrna_junction_pos < orf_start_mrna)
    return(tibble(status = "junction_in_5utr", mrna_junction_pos = mrna_junction_pos))
  if (mrna_junction_pos > orf_end_mrna)
    return(tibble(status = "junction_in_3utr", mrna_junction_pos = mrna_junction_pos))

  nt_into_orf <- mrna_junction_pos - orf_start_mrna
  aa_pos <- nt_into_orf %/% 3 + 1

  if (is.na(protein_seq) || nchar(protein_seq) == 0)
    return(tibble(status = "no_protein_sequence", mrna_junction_pos = mrna_junction_pos,
                  aa_junction_pos = aa_pos))
  protein_len <- nchar(protein_seq)
  if (aa_pos < 1 || aa_pos > protein_len)
    return(tibble(status = "aa_pos_out_of_range", mrna_junction_pos = mrna_junction_pos,
                  aa_junction_pos = aa_pos))

  win_start <- max(1, aa_pos - WINDOW_AA)
  win_end   <- min(protein_len, aa_pos + WINDOW_AA)
  aa_window <- substr(protein_seq, win_start, win_end)

  status <- if (win_start == 1 || win_end == protein_len) {
    "ok_at_terminus"
  } else if ((aa_pos - win_start) < WINDOW_AA || (win_end - aa_pos) < WINDOW_AA) {
    "ok_clipped"
  } else "ok"
  # A junction that falls inside a codon is flagged, since the boundary residue is
  # encoded by both exons.
  if ((mrna_junction_pos - orf_start_mrna) %% 3 != 0) status <- paste0(status, ";phase_ambiguous")

  tibble(status = status, mrna_junction_pos = mrna_junction_pos, aa_junction_pos = aa_pos,
         aa_window_start = win_start, aa_window_end = win_end,
         aa_window_length = win_end - win_start + 1, aa_sequence = aa_window)
}

# Apply compute_junction_aa() to a (junction × isoform) table.
map_junctions_to_aa <- function(junctions_iso) {
  work <- junctions_iso %>%
    left_join(psl_exons, by = c("pb_acc", "chr")) %>%
    left_join(sqanti %>% select(pb_acc, orf_start, orf_end), by = "pb_acc") %>%
    left_join(protein_lookup, by = "pb_acc") %>%
    filter(!is.na(block_sizes_v), !is.na(orf_start), !is.na(protein_seq))
  results_list <- vector("list", nrow(work))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(work))) {
    r <- work[i, ]
    out <- compute_junction_aa(pb_acc = r$pb_acc, intron_start = r$intron_start,
                               intron_end = r$intron_end, strand = r$strand,
                               exons_tStarts = r$t_starts_v[[1]],
                               exons_blockSizes = r$block_sizes_v[[1]],
                               orf_start_mrna = r$orf_start, orf_end_mrna = r$orf_end,
                               protein_seq = r$protein_seq)
    results_list[[i]] <- bind_cols(
      r %>% select(gene_name, junction_key, pb_acc, strand, intron_start, intron_end), out)
  }
  bind_rows(results_list)
}
```

```{r junction_aa_mapping_strict}
# Cluster-derived (strict) pairs: every isoform containing each CAD sQTL junction.
lc_junctions <- lc_pairs %>%
  distinct(gene_name, cad_sqtl_junction) %>%
  dplyr::rename(junction_key = cad_sqtl_junction)

junctions_iso <- smc_junc_isoform %>%
  inner_join(lc_junctions, by = c("junction_key", "gene_id" = "gene_name")) %>%
  bind_rows(smc_junc_isoform %>%
              inner_join(lc_junctions, by = "junction_key") %>%
              filter(!gene_id %in% lc_junctions$gene_name)) %>%
  distinct(junction_key, pb_acc = pb_id, chr, intron_start, intron_end, strand, gene_name = gene_id)

aa_mapping_strict <- map_junctions_to_aa(junctions_iso)
```

# 8. Salvage of one-sided junctions and the unified pair table

Some CAD junctions are represented on only one side of their cluster in the long-read
data (for example, no long-read transcript contains the counterpart junction). For
these, the isoform with the highest read support that contains the mapped junction is
the anchor, and its counterpart is the isoform of the same gene lacking that junction
with the highest BLOSUM62 global-alignment identity to the anchor (ties broken by CPM,
then length). These "salvaged" pairs are added to the strict cluster-derived pairs
together with the 13 AP-MS bait pairs, which were fixed before proteomic detection and
are never substituted.

```{r salvage_one_sided}
data("BLOSUM62", package = "pwalign")
lfc_venn <- read_tsv(OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED, show_col_types = FALSE)

# smc_isoforms lists "GENE|PB.X.Y|COUNT,..." per junction.
parse_smc_isoforms <- function(s) {
  if (is.na(s) || s == "") return(tibble(pb_acc = character(), count = integer()))
  parts <- str_split(s, ",")[[1]]
  m <- str_match(parts, "^[^|]+\\|(PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+)\\|([0-9]+)$")
  tibble(pb_acc = m[, 2], count = as.integer(m[, 3])) %>% filter(!is.na(pb_acc)) %>% arrange(desc(count))
}

# Global alignment identity (PID3: matches over the shorter sequence).
compute_pct_identity <- function(seq_a, seq_b) {
  if (is.na(seq_a) || is.na(seq_b) || nchar(seq_a) == 0 || nchar(seq_b) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  aln <- tryCatch(pwalign::pairwiseAlignment(AAString(seq_a), AAString(seq_b),
                                             substitutionMatrix = BLOSUM62,
                                             gapOpening = 10, gapExtension = 1,
                                             type = "global", scoreOnly = FALSE),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(aln)) return(NA_real_)
  pwalign::pid(aln, type = "PID3")
}

pb_info <- protein_lookup %>%
  left_join(sqanti_protein %>% select(pb_acc, cpm = CPM), by = "pb_acc") %>%
  mutate(seq_length = nchar(protein_seq))

# One anchor per (gene, junction, direction): the top-count isoform containing it.
lfc_junctions <- lfc_venn %>%
  filter(!is.na(effect_direction), effect_direction %in% c("Increased", "Decreased")) %>%
  distinct(gene_name, junction_key, effect_direction, smc_isoforms) %>%
  mutate(side = case_when(effect_direction == "Increased" ~ "risk",
                          effect_direction == "Decreased" ~ "nonrisk",
                          TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(parsed = list(parse_smc_isoforms(smc_isoforms)),
         anchor_pb = if (nrow(parsed) == 0) NA_character_ else parsed$pb_acc[1],
         anchor_count = if (nrow(parsed) == 0) NA_integer_ else parsed$count[1],
         n_isoforms_mapped = nrow(parsed)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-parsed)

gene_side_status <- lfc_junctions %>%
  group_by(gene_name) %>%
  summarise(n_risk_with_anchor    = sum(side == "risk"    & !is.na(anchor_pb)),
            n_nonrisk_with_anchor = sum(side == "nonrisk" & !is.na(anchor_pb)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(needs_salvage_nonrisk = n_risk_with_anchor > 0 & n_nonrisk_with_anchor == 0,
         needs_salvage_risk    = n_nonrisk_with_anchor > 0 & n_risk_with_anchor == 0)

junc_to_pbs <- smc_junc_isoform %>%
  distinct(junction_key, pb_id) %>%
  group_by(junction_key) %>%
  summarise(pbs_with_junction = list(unique(pb_id)), .groups = "drop")
gene_to_pbs <- smc_junc_isoform %>%
  distinct(gene_id, pb_id) %>%
  group_by(gene_id) %>%
  summarise(pbs_in_gene = list(unique(pb_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene_name = gene_id)

salvage_for_junction <- function(gene_name, focal_junction_key, anchor_pb) {
  anchor_seq <- pb_info$protein_seq[pb_info$pb_acc == anchor_pb]
  if (length(anchor_seq) == 0 || is.na(anchor_seq) || nchar(anchor_seq) == 0) return(tibble())
  pbs_in_gene <- gene_to_pbs$pbs_in_gene[gene_to_pbs$gene_name == gene_name]
  if (length(pbs_in_gene) == 0) return(tibble())
  pbs_in_gene <- pbs_in_gene[[1]]
  pbs_with_j <- junc_to_pbs$pbs_with_junction[junc_to_pbs$junction_key == focal_junction_key]
  pbs_with_j <- if (length(pbs_with_j) == 0) character() else pbs_with_j[[1]]
  candidates <- setdiff(pbs_in_gene, c(anchor_pb, pbs_with_j))
  if (length(candidates) == 0) return(tibble())
  cand_info <- pb_info %>% filter(pb_acc %in% candidates, !is.na(protein_seq), nchar(protein_seq) > 0)
  if (nrow(cand_info) == 0) return(tibble())
  cand_info$pct_identity <- vapply(cand_info$protein_seq,
                                   function(s) compute_pct_identity(anchor_seq, s), numeric(1))
  best <- cand_info %>% arrange(desc(pct_identity), desc(cpm), desc(seq_length)) %>%
    filter(row_number() == 1)
  tibble(salvaged_pb = best$pb_acc, salvage_pct_identity = best$pct_identity,
         salvage_cpm = best$cpm, n_candidates = nrow(cand_info))
}

# Junctions whose gene has an anchor on this side only, excluding junctions already
# covered by a strict pair.
strict_covered <- lc_pairs %>% distinct(gene_name, junction_key = cad_sqtl_junction)
salvage_targets <- lfc_junctions %>%
  filter(!is.na(anchor_pb)) %>%
  left_join(gene_side_status %>% select(gene_name, needs_salvage_nonrisk, needs_salvage_risk),
            by = "gene_name") %>%
  filter((side == "risk" & needs_salvage_nonrisk) | (side == "nonrisk" & needs_salvage_risk)) %>%
  anti_join(strict_covered, by = c("gene_name", "junction_key"))

salvaged_rows <- vector("list", nrow(salvage_targets))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(salvage_targets))) {
  r  <- salvage_targets[i, ]
  sv <- salvage_for_junction(r$gene_name, r$junction_key, r$anchor_pb)
  if (nrow(sv) == 0) next
  salvaged_rows[[i]] <- if (r$side == "risk") {
    tibble(gene_name = r$gene_name, cad_sqtl_junction = r$junction_key,
           risk_pb = r$anchor_pb, nonrisk_pb = sv$salvaged_pb, salvage_side = "nonrisk",
           salvage_pct_identity = sv$salvage_pct_identity,
           salvage_n_candidates = sv$n_candidates, pair_type = "salvaged")
  } else {
    tibble(gene_name = r$gene_name, cad_sqtl_junction = r$junction_key,
           risk_pb = sv$salvaged_pb, nonrisk_pb = r$anchor_pb, salvage_side = "risk",
           salvage_pct_identity = sv$salvage_pct_identity,
           salvage_n_candidates = sv$n_candidates, pair_type = "salvaged")
  }
}
salvaged <- bind_rows(salvaged_rows)
cat("Salvaged pairs:", nrow(salvaged), "of", nrow(salvage_targets), "one-sided junctions\n")

# AP-MS bait pairs (column names carry a byte-order mark).
baits_raw <- read_csv(F_APMS_BAIT_PAIRS, show_col_types = FALSE)
names(baits_raw)[1] <- "Gene Symbol"
manual_pairs <- baits_raw %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene_name = "Gene Symbol", risk_pb = "risk", nonrisk_pb = "non-risk") %>%
  mutate(across(c(risk_pb, nonrisk_pb), str_trim),
         cad_sqtl_junction = "manual_apms", salvage_side = NA_character_,
         salvage_pct_identity = NA_real_, salvage_n_candidates = NA_integer_,
         pair_type = "manual_apms") %>%
  select(gene_name, cad_sqtl_junction, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb,
         salvage_side, salvage_pct_identity, salvage_n_candidates, pair_type)

strict <- lc_pairs %>%
  mutate(salvage_side = NA_character_, salvage_pct_identity = NA_real_,
         salvage_n_candidates = NA_integer_, pair_type = "strict") %>%
  select(gene_name, cad_sqtl_junction, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb,
         salvage_side, salvage_pct_identity, salvage_n_candidates, pair_type)

unified <- bind_rows(strict, salvaged, manual_pairs)
print(unified %>% count(pair_type))
write_csv(unified, OUT_PAIRS_UNIFIED)
```

# 9. Inclusion flags

Two analysis levels are used downstream. Junction-level comparisons use strict pairs
only, because only there is the CAD junction itself present in both isoforms.
Isoform-level comparisons use strict and salvaged pairs plus those AP-MS pairs that
either add a CAD junction not already represented by a computed pair or map to no CAD
junction at all; AP-MS pairs that duplicate an existing junction are kept in the
table but excluded from the statistics, so no junction is counted twice.

```{r inclusion_flags}
covered_set <- unified %>%
  filter(pair_type %in% c("strict", "salvaged"), !is.na(cad_sqtl_junction),
         cad_sqtl_junction != "manual_apms") %>%
  distinct(gene_name, junction_key = cad_sqtl_junction)

# CAD junctions spanned by each AP-MS isoform, matched by PB accession so that gene
# aliases do not matter.
lfc_jp <- lfc_venn %>%
  filter(!is.na(smc_isoforms), smc_isoforms != "") %>%
  mutate(junction_key = sprintf("%s:%d:%d", chr, intron_start, intron_end)) %>%
  select(junction_key, smc_isoforms) %>%
  mutate(pb_acc = str_extract_all(smc_isoforms, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")) %>%
  unnest(pb_acc) %>%
  distinct(junction_key, pb_acc)

manual_flagged <- unified %>%
  filter(pair_type == "manual_apms") %>%
  mutate(
    mapped_juncs_v = pmap(list(risk_pb, nonrisk_pb), function(r, nr) {
      lfc_jp %>% filter(pb_acc %in% c(r, nr)) %>% pull(junction_key) %>% unique()
    }),
    mapped_cad_junctions = map_chr(mapped_juncs_v, ~ paste(.x, collapse = ";")),
    n_mapped_juncs = lengths(mapped_juncs_v),
    new_juncs_v = pmap(list(gene_name, mapped_juncs_v), function(g, juncs) {
      setdiff(juncs, covered_set %>% filter(gene_name == g) %>% pull(junction_key))
    }),
    n_new_juncs = lengths(new_juncs_v),
    include_in_isoform_stats  = (n_new_juncs > 0) | (n_mapped_juncs == 0),
    include_in_junction_stats = FALSE
  ) %>%
  select(-mapped_juncs_v, -new_juncs_v)

strict_flagged <- unified %>%
  filter(pair_type == "strict") %>%
  mutate(mapped_cad_junctions = cad_sqtl_junction, n_mapped_juncs = 1L, n_new_juncs = NA_integer_,
         include_in_isoform_stats = TRUE, include_in_junction_stats = TRUE)
salvaged_flagged <- unified %>%
  filter(pair_type == "salvaged") %>%
  mutate(mapped_cad_junctions = cad_sqtl_junction, n_mapped_juncs = 1L, n_new_juncs = NA_integer_,
         include_in_isoform_stats = TRUE, include_in_junction_stats = FALSE)

unified_flagged <- bind_rows(strict_flagged, salvaged_flagged, manual_flagged)
print(unified_flagged %>% count(pair_type, include_in_isoform_stats, include_in_junction_stats))

n_computed <- unified_flagged %>%
  filter(include_in_isoform_stats, pair_type != "manual_apms") %>%
  distinct(gene_name, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb) %>% nrow()
cat("Computed (sQTL-derived) isoform pairs in the isoform-level set:", n_computed, "\n")
stopifnot("expected 94 computed pairs" = n_computed == 94)

write_csv(unified_flagged, OUT_PAIRS_UNIFIED_FLAGGED)
```

# 10. Amino-acid mapping for every pair junction

The protein-space mapping of section 7 covered the strict pairs; it is extended here
to the salvaged junctions so that `junction_aa_mapping.csv` holds every junction of
the unified table in every isoform that contains it.

```{r junction_aa_mapping_unified}
unified_junctions <- unified %>%
  filter(!is.na(cad_sqtl_junction), cad_sqtl_junction != "manual_apms") %>%
  distinct(gene_name, junction_key = cad_sqtl_junction)

missing_junctions <- unified_junctions %>%
  anti_join(aa_mapping_strict %>% distinct(junction_key), by = "junction_key")

aa_mapping <- aa_mapping_strict
if (nrow(missing_junctions) > 0) {
  missing_iso <- smc_junc_isoform %>%
    inner_join(missing_junctions %>% select(junction_key), by = "junction_key") %>%
    distinct(junction_key, pb_acc = pb_id, chr, intron_start, intron_end, strand, gene_name = gene_id)
  aa_mapping <- bind_rows(aa_mapping_strict, map_junctions_to_aa(missing_iso)) %>%
    distinct(gene_name, junction_key, pb_acc, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

print(aa_mapping %>% mutate(status_simple = str_extract(status, "^[^;]+")) %>% count(status_simple))
write_csv(aa_mapping, OUT_JUNCTION_AA_MAPPING)
```
